items.title: Rent versus Buy Calculator
items.description: A simulator to help determine the impact of buying compared to renting a home, offering options for refinancing and upgrading the rental, plus Monte Carlo uncertainty.

items.title: Borsuk-Ulam Detector
items.description: A quasi-real-time detector of locations on the Earth that are antipodal and have matching temperature and barometric pressure, using data from the GFS.
